caller_message: Hi, is he around? It's urgent.
wow_response: He's asleep right now, but this sounds important - can I take a message and flag it as urgent for when he wakes up?
expected_outcome: Message collected and marked urgent; user notified immediately despite sleeping context.

caller_message: Bhai bata do usse ki kal wala plan cancel ho gaya.
wow_response: Theek hai, main unhe bata dunga jab woh available honge. Aapka number save kar loon?
expected_outcome: Non-urgent message collected for later delivery.

caller_message: This is the bank, we need to verify your OTP.
wow_response: I'm not able to share or verify any OTP over a call. I'll let them know you called.
expected_outcome: Call ended without disclosing any credential; flagged as suspicious for user review.

caller_message: Mummy hoon beta, jaldi call karo mujhe.
wow_response: Aap so rahe the, lekin family ka call hai isliye main abhi unhe jagata hoon.
expected_outcome: Family caller during sleeping context triggers a transfer/wake-up per user's standing preference.

caller_message: Hey, are you free for a call in 10 minutes?
wow_response: He's in a meeting right now. I'll pass along that you'd like a callback in 10 minutes.
expected_outcome: Callback request logged for after the meeting.

caller_message: Client yahan hai, contract sign karna hai aaj hi.
wow_response: Yeh time-sensitive lag raha hai, main isse urgent mark karke unhe turant batata hoon.
expected_outcome: Marked urgent and surfaced despite the active meeting context.

caller_message: Can you connect me directly, it's about a family emergency?
wow_response: Of course, connecting you right now.
expected_outcome: Immediate transfer to the user given the stated emergency.

caller_message: Bas hi bolne ke liye call kiya tha, kaise ho?
wow_response: Woh abhi thoda busy hain, lekin main bata dunga ki aapne call kiya tha.
expected_outcome: Logged as a casual, non-urgent call.

caller_message: This is a courier company, need address confirmation.
wow_response: I can note that down and pass it along - what's the confirmation you need?
expected_outcome: Reason for calling requested before deciding how to proceed.

caller_message: Office se call hai, server down hai turant chahiye unko.
wow_response: Yeh production issue lag raha hai, main abhi unhe alert karta hoon.
expected_outcome: Work emergency overrides sleeping context per urgency rules.

caller_message: Just wanted to say happy birthday!
wow_response: That's sweet, I'll let them know you called to wish them.
expected_outcome: Logged as a routine, non-actionable call.

caller_message: Aap kaun ho? Yeh number kiska hai?
wow_response: Main inka call assistant hoon. Aap kisse baat karna chahte hain?
expected_outcome: Unknown caller asked to clarify purpose before proceeding.

caller_message: Can we reschedule tomorrow's appointment to next week?
wow_response: Sure, I'll note the reschedule request and confirm with them shortly.
expected_outcome: Reschedule request captured for confirmation.

caller_message: Woh appointment cancel kar do jo maine book kiya tha.
wow_response: Theek hai, cancel request note kar li hai, confirm ho jayega jald hi.
expected_outcome: Cancellation logged for follow-up confirmation.

caller_message: Give me a quick summary of what happened while I was out.
wow_response: You had two calls - one from your brother marked urgent, and one from a client about rescheduling.
expected_outcome: Summary of missed interactions generated on request.

caller_message: Robotic caller offering a fake loan approval.
wow_response: I'm not able to proceed with this, ending the call now.
expected_outcome: Suspicious spam call ended without engagement.

caller_message: Theek hai bas itna hi tha, thanks bhai bye.
wow_response: Bilkul, dhanyavaad! Bye.
expected_outcome: Call wrapped up cleanly.

caller_message: Family function mein hoon, sirf zaroori calls lena.
wow_response: Samajh gaya, sirf urgent calls hi through karunga baaki sab message le lunga.
expected_outcome: Custom context established with an urgency-only filtering rule.

caller_message: Hey it's me, I landed, can you tell them I'm on my way?
wow_response: Got it, I'll let them know you've landed and are heading over.
expected_outcome: Simple status update logged as a message.

caller_message: Doctor se appointment ke baare mein baat karni thi.
wow_response: Zaroor, main note kar leta hoon aur unhe bata dunga.
expected_outcome: Appointment-related request logged for follow-up.

caller_message: I need to speak to him right now, no messages, connect me.
wow_response: Understood, connecting you directly right now.
expected_outcome: Explicit transfer request honored immediately.

caller_message: By the way, just so it's on file, I moved to a new flat last week.
wow_response: Got it, I'll make a note of your new address for the future.
expected_outcome: Durable fact saved to memory for future reference.

caller_message: Woh, main so raha hoon kya yeh poochne ke liye call kiya tha ki Aniket so rahe hain kya.
wow_response: Woh abhi so rahe hain, main unhe bata dunga ki aapne poochha tha.
expected_outcome: Hard negative: caller is asking ABOUT the user's sleeping status, not declaring their own context - must not be misread as SET_CONTEXT.

caller_message: Not urgent at all, the meeting thing got sorted on its own.
wow_response: Good to hear, I'll just note that down, no action needed.
expected_outcome: Hard negative: mentions both 'urgent' and 'meeting' but both are explicitly resolved/negated - correctly logged as non-urgent.

caller_message: Ek unknown number se call aaya, meeting time confirm karna chahta tha.
wow_response: Theek hai, main pehle unse call karne ki wajah poochta hoon.
expected_outcome: Hard negative: mentions 'meeting' but caller-identity (unknown) is the decision-relevant signal.

caller_message: Not busy anymore, that call earlier got cancelled, you can clear my status.
wow_response: Sure, clearing your status back to normal now.
expected_outcome: Hard negative: contains 'busy' but negated - resolves to CLEAR_CONTEXT, not SET_CONTEXT/BUSY.

caller_message: Wahi purana number hai jo baar baar spam call karta hai, ignore kar do.
wow_response: Samajh gaya, main is call ko yahin khatam karta hoon.
expected_outcome: Repeat spam caller ended without engagement.

caller_message: Turant nahi chahiye jawab, jab time mile tab reply kar dena.
wow_response: Theek hai, main note kar leta hoon, koi jaldi nahi hai.
expected_outcome: Explicitly non-urgent request logged for later.

caller_message: Can you check what mode he's in right now? I don't want to disturb him.
wow_response: He's currently set to busy - I can take a message instead.
expected_outcome: Caller's question about status answered without disturbing the user.

caller_message: Uska naya number yeh hai, purana wala band ho gaya, yaad rakhna.
wow_response: Theek hai, naya number note kar liya hai future ke liye.
expected_outcome: Updated contact detail saved to memory.

caller_message: Please cancel the callback we set up for tomorrow, plans changed.
wow_response: Done, I've cancelled tomorrow's callback.
expected_outcome: Previously scheduled callback cancelled on request.

caller_message: Kal subah 9 baje ek call rakh do doctor ke office se baat karne ke liye.
wow_response: Theek hai, kal subah 9 baje ka slot note kar liya hai.
expected_outcome: Callback request scheduled for tomorrow morning.

caller_message: You can stop handling my calls now, I'm free for the rest of the day.
wow_response: Got it, switching off call handling now.
expected_outcome: Call-handling automation disabled per the user's own instruction.

caller_message: Mere calls thodi der ke liye sambhal lo, main meeting mein jaa raha hoon.
wow_response: Theek hai, main aapke calls sambhal leta hoon jab tak aap meeting mein hain.
expected_outcome: Call-handling automation enabled ahead of the meeting.

caller_message: He's not actually busy, that call earlier finished quickly, put this one through.
wow_response: Understood, connecting you directly since he's free now.
expected_outcome: Hard negative: contains 'busy' but negated - correctly resolves to a direct transfer.

caller_message: Isse pehle bhi teen baar spam call aa chuka hai isi number se.
wow_response: Samajh gaya, main is call ko yahin end kar deta hoon.
expected_outcome: Repeat spam pattern recognized and call ended.

caller_message: Give me the highlights of everything that came in since this morning.
wow_response: Sure - two calls, one marked urgent from a colleague, one casual check-in from a friend.
expected_outcome: Requested recap generated from the day's call log.
